text:
product-claire: Big thanks for the turnout! Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — I captured the live asks and clarified a few roadmap points. Please read and claim items.

cto-sanjay: Short update on Dedicated GA timing: we've shifted one sprint to address autoscaler stability. New soft target week is 2025-07-14. Not final but don't promise GA to customers before June.

eng-lead-ryan: Rollout defaults we discussed: canary 10% for 24h, 50% for next 24h. Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx spike >3% OR p50 latency increase >30%. Example config we'll add to docs: 
```
{ "canary": 10, "stage_hours": 24, "rollback": ["5xx>3%","p50>30%"] }
```

ops-maya: Private (VPC) beta: internal onboarding starts 2025-05-05. KMS/HSM and extended audit logs enabled; default log retention 90 days. If a team needs >90d, file RED-2401.

product-claire: Action owners (short):
- Dedicated GA readiness: @cto-sanjay + @eng-lead-ryan — due 2025-06-30
- Private beta invites & onboarding doc: @ops-maya — due 2025-05-02
- Optimize rollout examples (batching/quant): @eng-lead-ryan — due 2025-04-11
- GA customer comms + FAQ draft: @mktg-jordan — due 2025-05-15
- Canary UI microcopy + rollback explainer: @design-anya + @eng-lead-ryan — due 2025-04-18

mktg-jordan: For comms, need clear list of what is GA-gated vs hosted-only. Sanjay, can you confirm?

cto-sanjay: GA gated: SLA-backed uptime, reserved capacity controls, burst capacity, single-tenant pools. Some hosted capabilities (expanded model catalog, early Optimize flags) remain feature-flagged post-GA.

design-anya: I'll upload UI screenshots and a microcopy doc to the docs repo by Thu: https://redwood.internal/docs/canary-ui-proposal :camera_flash:

eng-lead-ryan: Ops, can we add per-model token breakdown to rollout traces? Need that for cost diagnostics.

ops-maya: Filed RED-2470 for dashboard panels (per-model token + canary health). Dashboard preview: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/canary-health. deploy-bot scheduled job for 2025-04-08.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled job deploy/canary-dashboard for 2025-04-08 02:30 UTC (CI: ci-98234). :robot_face:

product-claire: Unassigned asks from Q&A — please claim in thread: cost model one-pager for large multitenant customers; migration checklist hosted->dedicated; SOC2/ISO mapping for Private.

eng-lead-ryan: I'll take migration checklist. First draft by 2025-04-15.

ops-maya: I'll own compliance mapping. Filing RED-2500 now.

mktg-jordan: I'll draft the cost model one-pager but need estimated per-token unit costs for main profiles — ops, can you share numbers?

product-claire: I'll open parent tracking ticket RED-2600 and link all subtasks. If you're assigned above, please add an ETA in the ticket. I'll consolidate blockers and escalate EOD tomorrow. DM me if you need reassignments. :handshake:
